card.name: Words leading into environmental topics
card.fires_on: Small linking words and verbs (with, more, use, buy, while, of) in eco-themed passages, just before an environment-related word or phrase is expected.

modes.label: Eco-advice phrasing
modes.description: Linking word or verb in green-living advice, right before words about eco-friendly or sustainable things.
modes.example: Choose more eco-friendly products<< with>> less impact and made by sustainable businesses.

modes.label: Policy and agency text
modes.description: Word just before 'environmental' or 'Environment' in names of reports, programs and conferences.
modes.example: It was announced on March 15 that a<< supplemental>> environmental impact statement will be issued

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word environment and related forms in several languages.
card.plain: It fires on small words in green-living or environmental-policy text where the word 'environment' is likely to come next.
